verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never shows vLLM loading several base models, or swapping the served model at runtime, without restarting the server. The only related item is multi-LoRA support. LoRA adapters are an adjacent feature, not switching between full models, so they earn no credit. The axis clearly applies to an inference server, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server
